documentation.file_docstring:
Tests for async adapter wrap/unwrap support.

Covers: async_pre_execute, async_post_execute, AsyncGovernedWrapper.
Uses pytest-asyncio — no real API calls.

Run with: python -m pytest tests/test_async_adapters.py -v --tb=short
inline_comments: Because of the lock, calls are serialized: start-X, end-X, start-Y, end-Y
Tests: sync methods still work unchanged (backward compatibility)
member_docstrings: DummyIntegration: Minimal concrete subclass for testing.
test_async_pre_execute_defaults_to_sync: async_pre_execute should delegate to sync pre_execute by default.
test_async_pre_execute_blocks_like_sync: async_pre_execute should respect blocked patterns just like sync.
test_async_post_execute_defaults_to_sync: async_post_execute should delegate to sync post_execute by default.
test_async_post_execute_increments_call_count: Each async_post_execute call should increment call_count.
test_governed_wrapper_passes: Wrapper should call through and return result when policy allows.
test_governed_wrapper_tracks_calls: Wrapper should increment call_count after each successful call.
test_governed_wrapper_blocks_on_pattern: Wrapper should raise PolicyViolationError when input matches blocked pattern.
test_governed_wrapper_blocks_on_max_calls: Wrapper should raise PolicyViolationError when max_tool_calls exceeded.
